summary: Deforms captured geometry using point weights from Capture SOP and animated capture regions or skeleton objects.

key_params.name: group
key_params.note: Point and/or primitive group to deform.

key_params.name: delcolatr
key_params.note: Delete capture color attributes after deformation.

key_params.name: donormal
key_params.note: Deform normals as well as positions.

key_params.name: skelrootpath
key_params.note: Skeleton root path used to resolve capture transforms.

common_gotchas: The input must contain compatible capture attributes or rig data.
Deleting capture attributes saves memory but prevents later deformation stages from reusing the weights.
`group` can refer to point and/or primitive groups, not only point groups.
key_concepts: Deform SOP applies Capture SOP weights and animated capture regions or skeleton transforms to captured geometry.
Procedural SOP edits can be inserted between Capture and Deform as long as required capture attributes survive.
`delcaptatr` and `delcolatr` are cleanup options for reducing downstream attribute clutter after deformation.
`donormal` deforms normals along with positions, and `skelrootpath` resolves skeleton object transforms.
